title: Mitrovica — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Mitrovica: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Mitrovica has a population of 46,000. A city in northern Kosovo on the Ibar River, known for its mining history (Trepča Mines), the Ibar Bridge, and its diverse ethnic communities. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 138 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
